title: History measurement series
responsibility: Groups unit growth and benchmark measurements without combining incompatible measurement definitions.

inputs.name: unitGrowth.records
inputs.description: Record identifiers and measurements in the order growth points should first appear.

inputs.name: unitGrowth.reviews
inputs.description: Optional map of reviewed budget histories by unit; defaults to an empty map.

inputs.name: historySeries.records
inputs.description: Record identifiers and benchmark measurements to group.

inputs.name: historySeries.focused
inputs.description: Optional focused runs; measurements from non-gapped points retain their tested revisions.

outputs.name: unitGrowth
outputs.description: Units sorted by id, each with one growth point per tested commit, measured source metrics and target sizes, unavailable/partial notes and any supplied reviews. Benchmark-specific size measurements are excluded.

outputs.name: historySeries
outputs.description: Benchmark groups by unit, workload, metric and target, with separate lines for different profiles, units, methods or comparison contexts. Only numeric values with workload and profile participate; eligible focused measurements retain their original revisions. Multiple lines mark a group incompatible.
